notes: Smaller installer and a Map Hack that explains itself. Setup is now 140 MB instead of 595 MB - the Diablo II map data is downloaded during install and checked against a SHA-256 hash before anything is written, so a corrupted or half-finished download can no longer leave you with a Map Hack that fails for no visible reason. The 'D2 LoD folder' setting is gone: the app uses the copy it installs and nothing else, because the map generator cannot run against an ordinary retail Diablo II install and fails silently when pointed at one. Map generation errors now say what went wrong and what it proves instead of a bare exit code. Also included: Steam accounts can be automated again - keyboard input works on Steam-launched D2R and the game no longer crashes on Tab.
